newsitem.title: USA: NRG Generating names Sherman president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: NRG Generating names Sherman president, CEO.

text.p: NRG Generting (U.S.) Inc said Monday it named Robert Sherman Jr. its new president and chief executive officer.
The company said Sherman, an executive at Cogen Technologies, will succeed Leonard Bluhm when he joins NRG in May. Bluhm will retain the post of chairman of the board, NRG said.
NRG Energy, a developer of electrical and thermal energy cogeneration projects, is 41.86-percent owned by the NRG Energy Inc division of Northern States Power Co.
Its shares were unchanged Monday at 11-1/4.
